## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes (typecheck, unit tests, load smoke, wire smoke)
- [ ] Tests cover the new behaviour (written first where possible)
- [ ] Fixtures are synthetic: no real transcripts, requests, session ids, hostnames, IP addresses or keys
- [ ] README updated where behaviour or configuration changed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line under `## [Unreleased]`
- [ ] No change to the config file's keys or meaning, or the change is called out above as breaking
- [ ] Any weakened guarantee (README *What it guarantees*) is called out above
